eventDetail.scope: This conference is the second edition of IEEE ISENSE, organized by the department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, IIIT Kottayam, aimed to promulgate the innovations and breakthroughs that occur in the contemporary world of Electronics and Communication Engineering. The conference encompasses 8 vital tracks such as:  1. VLSI & Embedded Systems  2. Communication Systems  3. IoT & Sensor Networks  4. Security & Privacy  5. RF, Microwave & Optics  6. Signal, Speech & Image Processing  7. Emerging Technologies: AI, ML, DL & NLP  8. Robotics & Automation  Apart from the main conference, it also motivates researchers to learn, unlearn and exemplify their talents in usage of advanced tools and technologies through tutorial sessions. Further, our conference is a platform for our viable sponsors to introduce and showcase their products relevant to research in the aforementioned fields.
